latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of institutional-site: a skill for building high-quality institutional websites in React with a visual-driven workflow.

- Creates professional sites using Vite, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and Framer Motion for animations.
- Designed to extract and organize logos, images, presentations, and other client-provided visual materials.
- Structured workflow: inventory of materials, requirements clarification with user, project setup, building, optimization, and delivery.
- Enforces best practices for accessibility, SEO, image optimization (WebP), and performance (code splitting, font loading).
- Handles both Portuguese and English sites; triggers on requests for institutional sites, landing pages, or when visual assets are provided.
